result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations for the Paris prize problem on heat conduction: conditions for isothermal surfaces (functions u of α, β), expressions of the Laplacian in curvilinear coordinates via the quadratic form coefficients and its discriminant Δ, and relations involving the components A, B, C formed from gradients of α and β.
